purpose: Make the frozen Legacy CSV t_k and published-field boundaries executable through semantic field identities while permitting encoding changes.

provenance.notes: An external C++17 harness was compiled against a clean frozen extraction with w64devkit GCC 16.2.0 and run twice. The main build verifies both dataset identities, fixture-local semantic mapping, a 50-digit Decimal trajectory, and an independent C++17 probe with no Legacy dependency.

expected_facts.claim: The three semantic samples identify t0=0, t1=0.5 s, and t2=1 s in exact row order.
expected_facts.tolerance_policy: Row identity, count, and order are exact; the frozen Legacy seed uses absolute time tolerance 1e-12.

expected_facts.claim: Altitude and vertical velocity come from the state published at each recorded t_k boundary.
expected_facts.tolerance_policy: The frozen Legacy state seed uses absolute tolerance 1e-9; target YYZ field tolerances remain pending R0-SCI-003.

expected_facts.claim: Header-based semantic mapping produces the same dataset after column permutation, finite numeric text reformatting, arbitrary unmapped-column changes and duplicate unmapped headers, and rejects missing or non-finite required values.
expected_facts.tolerance_policy: Required field identities occur exactly once; column position, finite Decimal-equivalent text form and unmapped columns are excluded after mapping; missing or duplicate mapped fields, NaN and infinities are rejected.

expected_facts.claim: The dataset is tied to the frozen archive, Simulator, logger, sink, PointMass seed test, capture harness, environment, and reconstructed raw CRLF byte identity.
expected_facts.tolerance_policy: Paths, byte counts, line-ending transformation, and SHA-256 values are exact.

acceptance: Verifies frozen source, environment, harness, runtime-test, stored-dataset, and reconstructed raw-capture identities
Two Legacy captures are byte-identical and normalize to the same three semantic rows
Independent 50-digit Decimal and C++17 implementations agree with every semantic row
Column permutation, finite Decimal-equivalent text, unmapped-column changes and duplicate unmapped headers are accepted after header mapping
Missing t0, shifted t_k, stale published state, missing or non-finite required values, and duplicate required header are rejected
Preserve and Retire recommendations remain visibly pending until the repository owner accepts the disposition choice
